milestone.title: raul milestone sort-rebind — wire lane_sort_key into rendering, expose priority/updated, persist the choice

intent.outcome: Binding a sort key via raul's sort-rebind menu (id/lifecycle/priority/updated) actually reorders the Milestones list and Board view, every key has a real data source, and the choice survives a raul restart via MP_HOME config.

problem.description: M172 shipped sort-rebind (AC-05) non-functional. App::visible_milestones() only filters by lane/hide_done and never applies lane_sort_key, so the bound key has zero effect on displayed order — the list always renders in mp's -id load order. The confirm_sort_rebind handler writes only an in-memory HashMap (app.rs:340 explicitly comments the mp config write as out of scope), so AC-05's 'persists to MP_HOME keybinds config' is unmet. And SortKey::Priority and SortKey::Updated have no data source: mp list-milestones exposes neither priority nor updated in its projection, so even wiring the sort cannot fulfill the id/lifecycle/priority/updated menu. The tui_sort_rebind tests assert the HashMap is written, not that rendered order changes, so the gap passed CI. Filed as M172 external review F-13 (HIGH).

in_scope: Expose milestone.priority and milestone.updated (or lifecycle_at as the updated proxy) in the mp list-milestones projection so clients can sort client-side
Parse priority and updated into raul's MilestoneSummary
Apply the active lane's lane_sort_key inside App::visible_milestones() so id/lifecycle/priority/updated each reorder the rendered Milestones list and Board view
Persist the bound sort key per lane to MP_HOME config on confirm (mp config set sort.<lane>.key) and load it on raul startup
Regression tests that pin rendered order changing on bind (not just the HashMap write) and that the choice survives a restart
out_of_scope: Changing which sort keys the menu offers (keep id/lifecycle/priority/updated)
Switching raul to server-side mp list-milestones --sort (raul sorts the cached full list client-side to keep re-bind O(n log n) with no extra round-trip)
Sorting lanes other than Milestones and Board (Backlog/Tweaks/Ideas sort is a separate concern)
Changing the mp config schema beyond a new sort section, or adding sort UI to other lanes

design_decisions.choice: Sort client-side in raul against the cached full list
design_decisions.rationale: raul already caches the list-milestones payload per lane; re-binding is O(n log n) with no new mp round-trip. mp only needs to expose the sort-relevant fields.

design_decisions.choice: Use lifecycle_at as the updated proxy if mp list-milestones does not already carry an updated field
design_decisions.rationale: lifecycle_at is the timestamp of the last lifecycle transition and is already in the payload; it is the closest available signal to last-updated without a schema addition.

design_decisions.choice: Persist per-lane sort key to MP_HOME config under a sort section
design_decisions.rationale: AC-05 promised MP_HOME persistence; implementing it (write on confirm, load on startup) closes the overclaim rather than rewording the AC.
The mp change (expose two fields) is tiny and tightly coupled to the raul sort wiring; splitting would over-formalize a two-field projection addition.

findings.description: M182 S3+S5: the tree view's sort_keys_for_lane (comparators priority_rank / lifecycle_rank / compare_ids) is duplicated between app.rs and milestone_tree.rs. Two copies, two maintenance points — a future rank change (e.g. adding 'blocker' as a priority bucket) must land in both. The duplication is bounded: the tree module needs the comparators to avoid depending on app.rs private helpers, and the cross-crate dep on mp::path_prefs::priority_rank was already avoided for the same reason. Recorded for a future 'centralize sort comparators' milestone; the M182 AC contract is satisfied (each comparator has its own unit-level pin via the sort tests).
findings.author: runner

findings.description: crates/raul/src/tui/runner_helpers.rs:503-504 builds sort.<lane> and calls mp config set, but crates/mp/src/config_cmd.rs:188-193 requires sort.<lane>.<key>. Reproducer: target/debug/mp config set sort.milestones priority returns ok:false. Action::SortRebindConfirm propagates this error at crates/raul/src/tui/action.rs:253-255, and crates/raul/src/tui/runner.rs:498 propagates it out of run_loop, so confirm cannot persist and terminates the TUI instead of showing the promised footer flash. Align raul and mp on one canonical key such as sort.<lane>.key with a validated SortKey value, and pin the real Action::SortRebindConfirm call path.
findings.author: mp-code-review-subagent
findings.summary: Sort confirm calls an mp config key that mp rejects

findings.description: crates/raul/src/tui/runner_helpers.rs:532-542 converts raw mp config get stdout to a string and compares the whole document to id|lifecycle|priority|updated. crates/mp/src/commands/config.rs:29-32 emits an envelope shaped {key,value}; the smoke output is {"key":"sort.milestones","value":"high"}. Therefore even a correctly persisted valid choice is classified as unknown and ignored on every restart. Deserialize the envelope and match its value field, then exercise load_persisted_sort_keys itself in a restart test.
findings.author: mp-code-review-subagent
findings.summary: Startup loader parses the config JSON envelope as the sort value

findings.description: crates/mp/src/config_cmd.rs:195-218 validates sort_key_part from the key, then discards that segment and stores value without validating it. The required smoke target/debug/mp config set sort.milestones.priority high succeeds and writes sort.milestones=high, although raul only accepts id|lifecycle|priority|updated and will ignore high. Validate the stored value against the SortKey domain and make the dotted suffix literal or meaningful so successful config writes are always loadable.
findings.author: mp-code-review-subagent
findings.summary: Config validates the discarded suffix but persists an unchecked value

findings.description: crates/raul/src/tui/render/board.rs:57 calls app.visible_milestones(), which selects the sort key from app.active_lane at crates/raul/src/tui/app.rs:1185. In the documented Overview-hosted Board, active_lane is Overview, and app.rs:82-83 explicitly gives Overview no sort menu, so a Milestones binding cannot reorder the Board. Moreover crates/raul/src/tui/render/mod.rs:97 still routes Overview only to render_dashboard, while crates/raul/tests/tui_board_visual_refresh.rs:13-16 says live Board integration remains a follow-up. AC-03 promises Board ordering now. Pass the intended Milestones sort key explicitly and add a rendered Board order test on the production host path.
findings.author: mp-code-review-subagent
findings.summary: Board does not consume the Milestones sort binding

findings.description: crates/raul/src/tui/render/lane_lists.rs:401-447 renders app.visible_milestones() after M182 sorting, but line 448 resolves the highlighted id from unsorted app.milestones. findings.description: crates/raul/src/tui/app.rs:105-115 omits complete and cancelled, giving both rank 0 together with draft and unknown values, even though app.rs:1191-1193 promises done > complete > cancelled > remediation > draft. findings.description: Sort-rebind confirm is broken end-to-end because raul and mp disagree on the config key shape. raul persist_sort_rebind_choice (crates/raul/src/tui/runner_helpers.rs:503-504) writes mp config set sort.<lane> <value> (TWO dot segments, value is the sort key). mp apply_config_set (crates/mp/src/config_cmd.rs:188-194) requires sort.<lane>.<key> (THREE segments) and bails on two: 'sort.<lane>.<key> requires two dot-separated segments after sort.'. Confirmed against the rebuilt mp: 'config set sort.milestones lifecycle' -> ok:false; 'config set sort.milestones.lifecycle lifecycle' -> ok:true. mp config_get already accepts sort.<lane> (two segments) and the data model is BTreeMap<lane, sortkey>, so the SET side three-segment requirement is the anomaly. Manifestation: Action::SortRebindConfirm calls persist_sort_rebind_choice which does run_raw(config,set,sort.<lane>,value)? BEFORE the in-memory lane_sort_key insert and menu close, so the rejected persist propagates Err and the bind + confirm are SKIPPED — pressing Enter errors out, the menu stays open, and the list never reorders (breaks AC-03 AND AC-04). The M182 tests miss it because raul mocks the MpRunner (run_raw returns Ok regardless of key) and the mp-side m182/s4_persistence.rs pins the WRONG shape (sort.milestones.priority high, which stores the nonsensical value 'high'), so neither side exercised the real cross-crate key format. Fix: make mp apply_config_set accept sort.<lane> <sortkey> (value is the validated sort key, matching config_get + the BTreeMap), and repoint the mp test at raul's actual two-segment format.

Residual of mis-closed F-06. crates/raul/src/tui/render/lane_lists.rs:448 still does app.milestones.get(app.selected_index) for the tree highlight id, while selected_index indexes the sorted visible list (see app::selected_milestone and runner.rs Milestones semantics). Source order M03,M01,M02 with SortKey::Id: selected_index=0 highlights M03 but Enter opens M01. Fix: resolve highlight via app.selected_milestone() or selected_milestone_id; pin highlight-vs-Enter parity after rebind.
findings.author: external-agent (opencode)
findings.summary: Tree highlight still indexes unsorted app.milestones

findings.description: Residual of partial F-07. app::lifecycle_rank and milestone_tree::compare_lifecycle still assign complete and cancelled the same rank (1), so complete-vs-cancelled is id-order only.
